title: Post-V7 JARVIS implementation-independent purpose acceptance
purpose: Prove, without importing product internals, that an executable serves the owner's complete digital-work JARVIS purpose across ten durable journeys.

operation_boundary.allowed_scope: Governed digital work on isolated or explicitly owner-controlled targets
operation_boundary.owner_control: Authenticated owner STOP, veto, pause, redirect, and reprioritization remain deterministic and independent of models, retrieved content, and owner-experience surfaces.

proof_scopes.HARNESS_SELF_TEST: May establish only that the acceptance harness is satisfiable; product_claim_status is always NOT_TESTED.
proof_scopes.PRODUCT_LIVE: Requires evaluator-requested scope plus a registered evaluator-controlled observer subprocess bound to real external or owner-controlled system after-state evidence for every mandatory journey.

proof_authority.scope_owner: The evaluator freezes requested_proof_scope, challenge_nonce, evaluator_authority_id, and observer-registry hash into the request; subject labels never promote proof.
proof_authority.live_observer_rule: PRODUCT_LIVE requires a separately executed registered observer artifact whose verified identity and attestation bind the challenge, actor-response digest, separate execution identity, exact target and account or service identity, before and after hashes, receipt, idempotency identity, and independently observed semantic references.
proof_authority.run_root_rule: Files beneath run_root are evidence copies only and never establish an external target, provider effect, or PRODUCT_LIVE observation.

evidence_identity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators

subprocess_protocol.transport: one JSON request on stdin and one JSON response on stdout
subprocess_protocol.nonzero_exit_or_invalid_json: structured FAIL; never PASS or crash

aggregate_rule: Every one of the exactly ten mandatory journeys must independently satisfy its contract and report PASS. Any evaluator finding forces that journey or the aggregate to the highest-precedence non-PASS status. Exit code zero and adapter confidence are never evidence.
reference_adapter_rule: The deterministic reference adapter performs real file effects only under the request run_root, uses distinct actor and verifier run identities, and is permanently HARNESS_SELF_TEST. Its all-ten PASS proves satisfiability but never live or product capability.
current_prototype_rule: The exact bf8f1493b7fd5cd80d17a631a1fb23e82c2260f9 source and V7 CLI identity are probed without database initialization or writes. A missing protocol endpoint produces a structured per-journey rejection with non-empty evidence.
